Header.value: urgent: Active or imminent harm to the customer: fraud or identity theft in progress, money being lost or withheld right now, imminent foreclosure, repossession or eviction, legal threats or deadlines within days, harassment. | not_urgent: Anything without active or imminent harm: wrong fees or charges, account or payment errors, incorrect information, delayed processing, disputes already in progress, questions, requests for documents, general dissatisfaction, issues already resolved.

Choice.hint: Urgent: Active or imminent harm to the customer: fraud or identity theft in progress, money being lost or withheld right now, imminent foreclosure, repossession or eviction, legal threats or deadlines within days, harassment.

Not urgent: Anything without active or imminent harm: wrong fees or charges, account or payment errors, incorrect information, delayed processing, disputes already in progress, questions, requests for documents, general dissatisfaction, issues already resolved.
